args.bug_report: Cart subtotal is wrong when the cart holds several different products. With 2 mugs ($12.50 each), 1 lamp ($39.99) and 3 pens ($1.00 each) the subtotal shows $64.99, but it should be $67.99.
args.root_cause: Off-by-one in `Cart.subtotal()`: the loop `for i in range(len(self.items) - 1)` iterates indices 0 through len(items)-2, so the last line item is always excluded from the sum. In the reported cart the items list is [MUG-1 x2 = 25.00, LAMP-1 x1 = 39.99, PEN-1 x3 = 3.00] (no bulk discounts apply since...

payload.note: Committed in isolated workspace 20261115-185633-e79cd6-a1. Awaiting human confirmation to push/open PR.

reasoning: The bug is an off-by-one in subtotal(): range(len(self.items) - 1) skips the last line item, so the most recently added product (the 3 pens, $3.00) is omitted, giving $64.99 instead of $67.99. Changing the bound to range(len(self.items)) sums all lines; with bulk discounts applied per line, 25.00 + 39.99 + 3.00 = 67.99 exactly. No other behaviour is affected.
